statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty'); model_name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); safe_cwd=""; if [ -n "$cwd" ] && [ "$(printf '%s' "$cwd" | jq -Rr 'explode | all(. >= 32 and . != 127 and (. < 128 or . > 159))')" = "true" ] && [ -d "$cwd" ]; then safe_cwd="$cwd"; fi; if [ -n "$safe_cwd" ]; then project_name=$(basename "$safe_cwd"); display_cwd="$safe_cwd"; else project_name="unknown"; display_cwd="unknown"; fi; git_branch=""; git_status=""; git_color=""; if [ -n "$safe_cwd" ] && git -C "$safe_cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then git_branch=$(git -C "$safe_cwd" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "detached"); if [ -n "$(git -C "$safe_cwd" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then git_color="\\033[33m"; git_status="✗"; else local_commit=$(git -C "$safe_cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse @ 2>/dev/null); remote_commit=$(git -C "$safe_cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse @{u} 2>/dev/null); if [ "$local_commit" != "$remote_commit" ] && [ -n "$remote_commit" ]; then git_color="\\033[36m"; git_status="↕"; else git_color="\\033[32m"; git_status="✓"; fi; fi; fi; printf "\\033[35m📁 %s\\033[0m  \\033[34m📂 %s\\033[0m" "$project_name" "$display_cwd"; if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then printf "  %b🌿 %s %s\\033[0m" "$git_color" "$git_branch" "$git_status"; fi; printf "  \\033[90m🤖 %s\\033[0m" "$model_name"; if [ -n "$used_pct" ]; then if [ $(echo "$used_pct > 80" | bc -l) -eq 1 ]; then ctx_color="\\033[31m"; elif [ $(echo "$used_pct > 60" | bc -l) -eq 1 ]; then ctx_color="\\033[33m"; else ctx_color="\\033[32m"; fi; printf "  %b📊 %.1f%%\\033[0m" "$ctx_color" "$used_pct"; fi
